description: "Reflections on the Decline of Science in England, and on Some of Its Causes" by Charles Babbage is a critical examination of the state of science in England, written during the early 19th century. The volume addresses various factors contributing to the observed decline in scientific inquiry, particularly in the more complex and abstract disciplines.
